title: 《黑神话：钟馗》看起来不如《悟空》宏大——但这很好
titleEn: Black Myth: Zhong Kui Doesn’t Look as Epic as Wukong – and That’s Great
summary: IGN评论文章，作者Tim Brinkhof认为《钟馗》的实机演示显示出比《悟空》更接地气、更注重故事和角色的方向，虽然初看不如前作宏大，但越思考越喜欢。提到战斗新增招架机制，并认为游戏可能更注重剧情和角色。
summaryEn: IGN opinion piece by Tim Brinkhof, arguing that Zhong Kui's gameplay reveal shows a grittier, more grounded approach compared to Wukong, which initially seemed disappointing but becomes more appealing upon reflection. Mentions new parrying mechanic and suggests the game may focus more on story and characters.

title: 钟馗神话考据：典故、符号与民俗源流

summary: blackmyth.game 编辑部系统梳理钟馗在先秦“终葵”驱邪器物、受屈书生、幽冥判官、门神镇宅等层面的复合形象，并解释蝙蝠、剑、官袍、符箓等符号的文化含义。文章强调这些是理解游戏视觉与主题的参照系，不构成对游戏剧情、系统或发售日的确认。
summaryEn: The blackmyth.game editorial desk systematically examines Zhong Kui's composite image across pre-Qin exorcism objects (Zhongkui), the wronged scholar, underworld judge, and door-god roles, explaining cultural meanings of bats, swords, official robes, and talismans. The article stresses these are reference frames for understanding the game's visuals and themes, not confirmations of plot, systems, or release dates.
